validatedDesign.barrier: The observed matching Host resume request occurs after WindowsCapturedProcess.installOwner set the exact original prepared allocation installed, and after HostWindowsLaunch awaited that callback. Holding the request before original.handle prevents the selected physical Resume from being forwarded. This proves completed-install/pre-Resume, not interruption inside the callback.
validatedDesign.scope: Use one finite Codex profile, one Main owner, two captured Host attachments, one original capability/prepared root and an independent original HANDLE. A closed TEST loss selector enables existing wrapper code without activating packaged lead/storage behavior.
validatedDesign.pendingReply: After actual A exit the held callback must reject/finish without forwarding or constructing an ACK. CapturedHostClient already turns private port rejection into UNKNOWN and ignores replies after transport sealing.
validatedDesign.durability: Original prepareSessionOpen persists opening/custody-unknown, fingerprint and incarnation before driverFactory allocation. Cold public reconcile writes held/unknown and unready without replacing those identity fields or adopting a driver. Original claimed Team attempt and Runtime open fingerprint both fence replay.
validatedDesign.negatives: Stale A attachment and B noncleanup input/Resume for the original allocation are rejected by existing Main ownership checks; unknown numeric PID in ordinary Runtime payload is rejected by strict schema. These prove those boundaries, not a fresh-generation launch.
validatedDesign.cleanup: Main.close must confirm original stop/drain/release and HANDLE absence. Cold Host shutdown confirms only its child exit; durable unresolved Runtime debt must remain held/unknown and may become sealed. Physical absence is not runtime.closed or complete Host provider cleanup.
validatedDesign.oldOracles: Existing wrappers, ordinary Codex/V1 provider journey counters and all successful SourceScenario resumed/stopped/drained/released/HANDLE predicates remain exact. New intentional unresumed evidence is separate.

Require one original parent sentinel to survive the fault and targeted cleanup, then preserve its existing normal outer cleanup and controller drained/rootExit0/activeProcesses0 oracle.

Original finite peer connection/effect absence alone is not a generic proof that no machine instruction executed; bind the pre-physical-Resume claim to the held original request and original prepared/suspended broker contract.
Preserve all original clocks and callback/admission checks; no increased timeout, native action replay, new producer pin, or blanket cleanup success.
